`class ListSignal<E>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Signal<List<E>>`](/reference/signals/signal/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.impl.iterable` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ListSignal.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/impl/iterable/ListSignal.java)

Signal of a list, changed through its own methods so that every change notifies the nodes and listeners that follow it.

## Description

The value is a read-only copy: `get()` returns a list that throws `UnsupportedOperationException` on any change.
Each method of the signal copies the list, applies the change to the copy and writes it; called from another thread, the change applies on the render thread to the list held then.
The read methods (`get(int)`, `size()`, `contains(...)`…) record the read like [`Signal.get`](/reference/signals/signal/#Signal-method-get).
